0.en: Mark had the utility vehicle rolling out of the laboratory lot before Jack's door was fully shut, steering one-handed with the radio already at his mouth.
0.id: Mark sudah melajukan kendaraan utilitas keluar dari pelataran laboratorium sebelum pintu di sisi Jack tertutup rapat, menyetir dengan satu tangan sementara radionya sudah di depan mulut.

1.en: Medical first. Doctor Mercer, this is Jones. Doctor Bennett wants you briefed in person. I'll have someone at your door in ten minutes.
1.id: Medis dulu. Dokter Mercer, ini Jones. Dokter Bennett ingin Anda diberi penjelasan langsung. Sepuluh menit lagi akan ada orang di depan pintu Anda.

2.en: Doctor Mercer's reply crackled back, dry as ever.
2.id: Balasan Dokter Mercer terdengar berderak, sekering biasanya.

3.en: I've been briefed. I looked out the window.
3.id: Saya sudah dapat penjelasan. Saya melihat ke luar jendela.

4.en: Then consider this the official version.
4.id: Kalau begitu, anggap saja ini versi resminya.

5.en: Is the official version any better?

6.en: Mark glanced at Jack. Jack shook his head.

8.en: Wonderful. I'll put the coffee on.

9.en: The settlement looked strange in daylight. Not damaged. Not even different, exactly. The same streets, the same houses, the same row of bicycles leaning against the same fence outside the housing block. But above every rooftop, where there should have been open sky, the grass rose like a green forest that had grown up overnight, gold at the tips where the sun touched it.
9.id: Permukiman itu tampak aneh di siang hari. Tidak rusak. Bahkan tidak juga berbeda, persisnya. Jalan-jalan yang sama, rumah-rumah yang sama, deretan sepeda yang sama bersandar di pagar yang sama di depan blok hunian. Tapi di atas setiap atap, di tempat yang seharusnya langit terbuka, rumput menjulang seperti hutan hijau yang tumbuh dalam semalam, keemasan di ujung-ujungnya yang tersentuh matahari.

11.en: A man in a bathrobe stood in his front yard holding a coffee mug he had forgotten to drink, his head tipped all the way back. Two houses down, a woman had stepped onto her porch with a toddler on her hip. The child was pointing up and laughing.
11.id: Seorang laki-laki berjubah mandi berdiri di halaman depan rumahnya, memegang cangkir kopi yang lupa ia minum, kepalanya mendongak sejauh mungkin. Dua rumah dari situ, seorang perempuan melangkah ke teras sambil menggendong balita di pinggangnya. Anak itu menunjuk ke atas dan tertawa.

12.en: Mark slowed beside the man in the bathrobe and leaned out the window.
12.id: Mark memperlambat kendaraan di samping laki-laki berjubah mandi itu dan mencondongkan badan ke luar jendela.

13.en: Morning, sir. Inside, please. Doors closed.
13.id: Pagi, Pak. Masuk ke dalam, ya. Pintu ditutup.

18.en: Believe me, I had the same conversation with myself last night. Inside, please. There'll be an announcement soon.
18.id: Percayalah, semalam saya juga berdebat begitu dengan diri sendiri. Masuk ke dalam, ya. Sebentar lagi akan ada pengumuman.

19.en: The man went, slowly, still looking up.
19.id: Laki-laki itu menurut, pelan-pelan, masih sambil mendongak.

20.en: Jack's wrist terminal chirped. Sarah's voice came through, steady and close.
20.id: Terminal pergelangan Jack berbunyi. Suara Sarah terdengar, mantap dan dekat.

21.en: Lena has the greenhouse cameras. There are two on the outside wall, one inside. I can see Aiden. He's standing very still in the middle aisle.
21.id: Lena sudah pegang kamera rumah kaca. Ada dua di dinding luar, satu di dalam. Aku bisa lihat Aiden. Dia berdiri diam sekali di lorong tengah.

22.en: Good. Is the spider still there?

23.en: It hasn't moved since he called.

26.en: Clearly enough that I'd rather not.
26.id: Cukup jelas sampai aku lebih suka tidak melihatnya.

28.en: For the record, I'm with Aiden. That's bigger than a delivery truck.
28.id: Sebagai catatan, aku setuju dengan Aiden. Itu lebih besar daripada truk pengiriman.

29.en: Jack watched the greenhouse roof rise into view at the end of the street.
29.id: Jack memperhatikan atap rumah kaca muncul di ujung jalan.

32.en: The greenhouse sat at the far western edge of the developed zone, a long glass building with a peaked roof and white steel ribs, rows of seedlings and vegetable beds glowing green behind the panes. Jack had walked past it a hundred times without thinking about it.
32.id: Rumah kaca itu berdiri di ujung paling barat zona terbangun, sebuah bangunan kaca memanjang dengan atap runcing dan rusuk-rusuk baja putih, deretan bibit dan bedengan sayur berpendar hijau di balik panel-panelnya. Jack sudah ratusan kali melewatinya tanpa memikirkannya.

33.en: He had never noticed how close it stood to the end of the pavement.
33.id: Ia tidak pernah memperhatikan betapa dekatnya bangunan itu dengan ujung jalan beraspal.

34.en: A few meters past its outer wall, the road simply stopped, and the wilderness began.
34.id: Beberapa meter melewati dinding luarnya, jalan itu begitu saja berhenti, dan alam liar dimulai.

35.en: Mark parked behind the building, out of sight of the western glass, and killed the motor. For a moment they both sat there, listening.
35.id: Mark memarkir kendaraan di belakang bangunan, tak terlihat dari kaca sisi barat, lalu mematikan mesin. Sesaat mereka berdua hanya duduk di sana, mendengarkan.

36.en: Birdsong. The tick of the cooling engine. Somewhere far off, the low rush of wind moving through grass the size of trees.
36.id: Kicau burung. Detak mesin yang mendingin. Di suatu tempat jauh, desau rendah angin yang bergerak menembus rumput sebesar pohon.

38.en: You want me to go first?

39.en: I want neither of us to go first.
39.id: Maunya tidak ada di antara kita yang duluan.

41.en: They went in through the service door at the back. Warm, damp air wrapped around them, heavy with the smell of soil and tomato leaves. Long rows of grow lights hung from the steel frame overhead, still burning a soft violet white, though the sun had already risen outside.
41.id: Mereka masuk lewat pintu servis di belakang. Udara hangat dan lembap menyelimuti mereka, pekat dengan bau tanah dan daun tomat. Deretan panjang lampu tanam tergantung dari rangka baja di atas, masih menyala putih keunguan yang lembut, padahal matahari di luar sudah terbit.

42.en: Aiden stood exactly where Sarah had said, halfway down the center aisle.
42.id: Aiden berdiri persis di tempat yang dikatakan Sarah, di tengah-tengah lorong utama.

43.en: He was younger than Jack had expected from his voice, maybe twenty-five, in muddy boots and a green work apron. He was holding a pesticide fogger in both hands, the nozzle aimed at the far wall like a rifle, and he was shaking.
43.id: Ia lebih muda daripada yang Jack bayangkan dari suaranya, mungkin dua puluh lima tahun, bersepatu bot berlumpur dan bercelemek kerja hijau. Ia memegang alat pengasap pestisida dengan kedua tangan, moncongnya diarahkan ke dinding seberang seperti senapan, dan tubuhnya gemetar.

45.en: Aiden, I'm Jack Bennett. We talked on the radio.
45.id: Aiden, aku Jack Bennett. Kita bicara lewat radio tadi.

48.en: I will. First, put that down.
48.id: Akan kujelaskan. Tapi letakkan itu dulu.

50.en: Mark moved slightly to the left, slowly, keeping his hands visible.
50.id: Mark bergeser sedikit ke kiri, perlahan, membiarkan tangannya tetap terlihat.

51.en: What's the plan with that, exactly?

52.en: If it comes through the glass, I spray it.
52.id: Kalau dia menembus kaca, aku semprot.

53.en: Jack walked closer, keeping his voice level.
53.id: Jack berjalan mendekat, menjaga suaranya tetap datar.

54.en: That fogger is meant for aphids. If you sprayed that thing with it, it might not even notice. And if you fill this building with insecticide, you're the one who has to breathe it.
54.id: Alat itu untuk kutu daun. Kalau kamu menyemprot makhluk itu dengannya, mungkin dia bahkan tidak sadar. Dan kalau kamu memenuhi bangunan ini dengan insektisida, kamu sendiri yang harus menghirupnya.

55.en: Aiden's hands tightened on the fogger. Then, very slowly, he lowered the nozzle until it pointed at the floor.
55.id: Genggaman Aiden di alat pengasap itu mengencang. Lalu, sangat perlahan, ia menurunkan moncongnya sampai mengarah ke lantai.

59.en: Jack turned and looked through the western glass.
59.id: Jack berbalik dan memandang ke luar lewat kaca sisi barat.

60.en: For a second, he didn't understand what he was seeing. The grass outside was a wall of green stems, sunlight pouring through them in long slanted beams. Then part of that wall resolved into something that was not grass at all.
60.id: Sedetik, ia tidak mengerti apa yang dilihatnya. Rumput di luar adalah dinding batang-batang hijau, sinar matahari tercurah menembusnya dalam berkas-berkas panjang yang miring. Lalu sebagian dinding itu menjelma menjadi sesuatu yang sama sekali bukan rumput.

61.en: It sat low among the stems, just past the end of the pavement, facing the greenhouse.
61.id: Makhluk itu mendekam rendah di antara batang-batang rumput, tepat melewati ujung jalan beraspal, menghadap rumah kaca.

62.en: Black. Thickly furred, like a coat of short dark velvet, with bands of white across its back. Its legs were folded close beneath it. And on the front of its head, set side by side, were two enormous dark eyes, round and glossy as the headlights of a parked car, staring straight at the glass.
62.id: Hitam. Berbulu tebal, seperti mantel beledu gelap yang pendek, dengan pita-pita putih melintang di punggungnya. Kaki-kakinya terlipat rapat di bawah tubuh. Dan di bagian depan kepalanya, berdampingan, ada dua mata gelap yang sangat besar, bulat dan mengilap seperti lampu depan mobil yang diparkir, menatap lurus ke kaca.

65.en: Okay. That's not a delivery truck.

68.en: It's more like a car. A small car.

69.en: It looked bigger when it was looking at me.
69.id: Tadi kelihatan lebih besar waktu dia menatapku.

71.en: Thank you, Officer, that's very helpful.
71.id: Terima kasih, Pak Petugas, itu sangat membantu.

72.en: Jack didn't move. Neither did the spider. Only its eyes seemed alive, two black mirrors with the whole greenhouse reflected in them.
72.id: Jack tidak bergerak. Laba-laba itu juga tidak. Hanya matanya yang seolah hidup, dua cermin hitam dengan seluruh rumah kaca terpantul di dalamnya.

73.en: He spoke softly into his wrist.
73.id: Ia berbicara pelan ke pergelangan tangannya.

75.en: Her voice had gone very calm, which meant she was working.
75.id: Suaranya sudah menjadi sangat tenang, yang artinya ia sedang bekerja.

76.en: I'm seeing it. Jack, it's tracking you. Every time you move, the front of its body turns a little.
76.id: Aku lihat. Jack, dia mengikutimu. Setiap kali kamu bergerak, bagian depan tubuhnya ikut berputar sedikit.

78.en: Aiden made a small, strangled sound that might have been a laugh.
78.id: Aiden mengeluarkan bunyi kecil yang tercekik, yang mungkin saja tawa.

82.en: Aiden wiped his forehead on his sleeve, the fogger still dangling from one hand.
82.id: Aiden menyeka dahinya dengan lengan baju, alat pengasap masih tergantung di satu tangan.

83.en: I know what it is when it's the size of a pea. We like them in here. They eat aphids, whiteflies, all the stuff that gets into the seedlings. We never spray when we see one. They're friendly.
83.id: Aku tahu itu apa kalau ukurannya sebesar kacang polong. Kami suka mereka di sini. Mereka makan kutu daun, kutu kebul, semua hama yang masuk ke bibit. Kami tidak pernah menyemprot kalau melihat satu. Mereka ramah.

84.en: Mark kept his eyes on the glass.

86.en: When they're the size of a pea.

89.en: Jack crouched slightly, slowly, watching the spider's head follow him down by a fraction.
89.id: Jack sedikit merunduk, perlahan, memperhatikan kepala laba-laba itu ikut turun mengikutinya, sedikit saja.

90.en: If they're hunters, why isn't it hunting?
90.id: Kalau mereka pemburu, kenapa dia tidak berburu?

92.en: Because it's cold. They hunt by sight, in daylight. Mornings like this, they sit in the sun and warm up before they do anything. It hasn't moved since I called you because it's waiting.
92.id: Karena dia kedinginan. Mereka berburu dengan penglihatan, di siang hari. Pagi-pagi begini, mereka duduk berjemur sampai hangat dulu sebelum melakukan apa pun. Dia tidak bergerak sejak aku meneleponmu karena dia sedang menunggu.

94.en: Aiden glanced up at the sunlight sliding down through the grass.
94.id: Aiden melirik ke atas, ke sinar matahari yang merayap turun menembus rumput.

96.en: Sarah's voice came through Jack's wrist.
96.id: Suara Sarah terdengar dari pergelangan Jack.

97.en: Then it chose this spot for a reason. Jack, look at the glass.
97.id: Berarti dia memilih tempat ini ada alasannya. Jack, lihat kacanya.

99.en: At first he saw only smears of condensation. Then he saw what was clinging to the outside of the panes, all along the western wall. Moths, pale and dusty, with wings as wide as a man's outstretched arms. Flies the size of dogs, glossy and sluggish, crawling slowly toward the patches where the sun was beginning to warm the glass.
99.id: Mula-mula ia hanya melihat noda-noda embun uap. Lalu ia melihat apa yang menempel di sisi luar panel-panel kaca, di sepanjang dinding barat. Ngengat, pucat dan berdebu, dengan sayap selebar rentangan lengan orang dewasa. Lalat sebesar anjing, mengilap dan lamban, merayap pelan ke bagian-bagian kaca yang mulai dihangatkan matahari.

101.en: The grow lights. Aiden, do they run all night?
101.id: Lampu tanamnya. Aiden, apa lampunya menyala semalaman?

102.en: Every night. The seedlings need eighteen hours.
102.id: Setiap malam. Bibitnya butuh delapan belas jam.

104.en: Then every insect on this side of the island has been flying at your glass since dark. And that is breakfast. Lined up in a window.
104.id: Berarti semua serangga di sisi pulau ini sudah terbang ke kaca kalian sejak gelap. Dan itu sarapan. Berjajar di etalase.

105.en: So it's not here for us.
105.id: Jadi dia ke sini bukan untuk kita.

106.en: Sarah didn't let him off that easily.
106.id: Sarah tidak membiarkannya lolos semudah itu.

107.en: It's not here for us yet. It came for them. We just happen to be on the other side of the menu.
107.id: Belum untuk kita. Dia datang untuk mereka. Kita kebetulan saja berada di sisi lain menu.

108.en: Jack felt something in his chest loosen slightly. Not much. Enough. An animal that wanted flies was a problem. A monster that wanted people was a different kind of problem entirely.
108.id: Jack merasakan sesuatu di dadanya sedikit mengendur. Tidak banyak. Cukup. Hewan yang mengincar lalat adalah masalah. Monster yang mengincar manusia adalah jenis masalah yang sama sekali lain.

110.en: Okay. So we stay inside, we stay still, and we wait for it to eat and leave.
110.id: Oke. Jadi kita tetap di dalam, kita tetap diam, dan kita tunggu dia makan lalu pergi.

111.en: Aiden looked from Jack to the glass and back again.
111.id: Aiden memandang Jack, lalu kaca, lalu Jack lagi.

113.en: That's the plan for the next ten minutes.
113.id: Itu rencana untuk sepuluh menit ke depan.

114.en: Aiden opened his mouth. Then he closed it again and looked up at the roof, and Jack watched the color drain out of his face.
114.id: Aiden membuka mulut. Lalu ia menutupnya lagi dan mendongak ke atap, dan Jack melihat wajahnya memucat.

120.en: Aiden pointed up. Jack followed the line of his finger to the peak of the roof, where a long row of glass panels sat closed along both sides, each one hinged at the top and connected to a thin steel arm.
120.id: Aiden menunjuk ke atas. Jack mengikuti arah jarinya ke puncak atap, tempat sederet panjang panel kaca terpasang tertutup di kedua sisi, masing-masing berengsel di bagian atas dan tersambung ke sebatang lengan baja tipis.

121.en: Aiden's voice dropped to a whisper.

122.en: The roof vents open on a timer. Every morning. Seven o'clock. To let the heat out.
122.id: Ventilasi atap terbuka otomatis pakai pengatur waktu. Setiap pagi. Jam tujuh. Untuk membuang panas.

124.en: The panel's by the front door.

125.en: The front door was at the far end of the building. The western glass was between here and there, the whole way.
125.id: Pintu depan ada di ujung lain bangunan. Kaca sisi barat membentang di antara sini dan sana, sepanjang jalan.

126.en: Jack opened his mouth to answer.

127.en: Above them, a motor whirred to life.
127.id: Di atas mereka, sebuah motor berdengung hidup.

128.en: One after another, down the length of the roof, the steel arms began to push, and the vent panels began to lift, opening long bright gaps into the morning air.
128.id: Satu demi satu, sepanjang atap, lengan-lengan baja itu mulai mendorong, dan panel-panel ventilasi mulai terangkat, membuka celah-celah panjang yang terang ke udara pagi.

129.en: Outside, the spider's two great eyes tilted upward, toward the sound.
129.id: Di luar, kedua mata besar laba-laba itu mendongak, ke arah bunyi itu.
